data.long_meaning: Goru is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gauri', which means 'Radiant' or 'Golden'. In Hinduism, Goru is a name for the Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. She is considered the embodiment of love, fertility, and prosperity. Goru is believed to bring good fortune and protect her devotees from harm. The name Goru carries the meaning “Goddess of abundance and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Goru usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of abundance and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
